premises.text: Email remains central to cloud workers' workflows but traps attachments as a content silo
premises.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo. Stuff just gets stuck in there

premises.text: A Chrome extension connects email to cloud services so attachments move into those services while staying linked to the email context
premises.evidence_span: move these files directly into other cloud services and keep them associated with the context of the original email

premises.text: Rules can automatically route incoming attachments from specified senders into the correct cloud folders
premises.evidence_span: automatically send everything that she's receiving from this big enterprise company directly into the correct contract folder

premises.text: Files can be attached from the cloud with access-control permissions limited to designated recipients
premises.evidence_span: attaches the file directly from the cloud and sets access control permissions on it

premises.text: Admin policies and an event dashboard give teams consistent cross-app data handling and visibility into ownership and workflow
premises.evidence_span: sets policies across the cloud applications that they use so that she can make sure that data is being consistently handled

premises.text: The product is free for individuals and paid when a group is claimed to govern shared data workflow
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless is completely free for individual users. You only pay when you claim a group of people

value.text: A simple secure workflow that moves and governs data across the enterprise cloud
value.evidence_span: offers a simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud that users and IT will love

causal_links.evidence_span: data is moving seamlessly from one application to another
gains visibility into data ownership and workflow across her team
appealing directly to individual users and functional business units

notes: Salesforce autofill and Yammer analytics examples folded as future platform cascade of the connect-and-move mechanism, not separate premises. Outlook availability treated as channel detail of the email connector. Market-size capture claim left as framing. Singletons D2 and D3 retained as separately revisable governance and pricing modules.
